questions: Should the function follow symlinks during directory traversal (i.e., should os.walk be called with followlinks=True or False)?

If execute_files is True and a matching file fails to execute (e.g., permission error, non-executable), should the function raise an exception, skip that file, or include an error indicator in results?
Should the pattern matching be case-sensitive? The reference uses re.search without flags.
Should the function search only for files directly matching the pattern, or also consider files where the pattern matches part of the filename? The reference uses re.search, implying substring match.
If execute_files is True, should the function wait for each subprocess to finish before proceeding, or execute concurrently? The reference uses subprocess.run which blocks.
Should the function decode subprocess stdout with a specific encoding other than UTF-8 if decode fails? The reference uses 'utf-8' hardcoded.
Should the function include directories in the search, or only regular files? The reference iterates over filenames from os.walk.
